facts.title: Learn Alchemy
facts.location: Miao'zan, first hut on the left, Sen'jin Village
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Whuut in the Drag, Orgrimmar, also teaches Apprentice. Empty Vials are sold by Alchemy Supply and Trade Supply vendors.

facts.title: Learn Alchemy
facts.location: Alchemist Mallory, cottage in the hills between Stormwind and Northshire
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Tel'Athir in the Alchemy Needs shop, Mage Quarter, Stormwind, also teaches Apprentice. Empty Vials are sold by Alchemy Supply and Trade Supply vendors.

facts.title: Alchemy 1-55: Minor Arcane Elixir, then Elixir of Minor Defense
facts.note: 1-10: 9 Minor Arcane Elixir (Peacebloom and an Empty Vial each), or Elixir of Minor Force with Silverleaf. 10-55: 45 Elixir of Minor Defense (Silverleaf, Peacebloom and an Empty Vial each).

facts.title: Journeyman Alchemy
facts.location: Yelmak, Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions, the Drag, Orgrimmar
facts.note: Needs Alchemy 50 and level 10. Whuut in the same shop teaches only Apprentice.

facts.title: Journeyman Alchemy
facts.note: Needs Alchemy 50 and level 10. Tel'Athir in the same quarter teaches only Apprentice.

facts.title: Alchemy 55-150: mana potions and elixirs
facts.note: 55-65 Minor Mana Potion; 65-90 Elixir of Minor Fortitude (yellow at 80); 90-120 Elixir of Wisdom; 120-130 Lesser Mana Potion; 130-150 Fire Oil from Firefin Snapper (keep 30 for Elixir of Fire Power), or more Lesser Mana Potions.

facts.title: Expert Alchemy is in Undercity
facts.location: Doctor Herbert Halsey, the Apothecarium, Undercity
facts.note: Needs Alchemy 125 and level 20; 50 silver. He is the only Horde Expert trainer listed. The Fermenter, a camp crafting station, needs Alchemy 140 and a blueprint from Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

facts.title: Expert Alchemy is in Darnassus
facts.note: Needs Alchemy 125 and level 20; 50 silver. Linzy Blackbolt in Dalaran is also listed, but the trainer page says she may be bugged in the beta. The Fermenter, a camp crafting station, needs Alchemy 140 and a blueprint from Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
